name: Kingdom of Morocco

areaKm2.note: asOf 2024. Surface area 446,550 km2 (AG.SRF.TOTL.K2); low is land area 446,300 km2 (AG.LND.TOTL.K2). Morocco proper as in ne:MAR; Western Sahara (~266,000 km2, mostly Moroccan-administered) excluded.

population.note: asOf 2025 (World Bank SP.POP.TOTL 38,430,770). Low -1% / high +1.5% for 2026 growth and estimate uncertainty. World Bank figure follows the national census, which includes residents of the Moroccan-administered "southern provinces"; Natural Earth MAR polygon excludes Western Sahara.

activePersonnel.note: IISS Military Balance 2026 p.369 as quoted: 195,800 active. CIA Factbook 2025: ~220,000 incl. 20,000 Gendarmerie (high). Paramilitary 50,000 excluded.

supportPersonnel.note: Active 195,800 minus infantry P roles (120,000). Covers air force, navy, Royal Guard support, crews and logistics.

mobilizationRatio.note: Analogy to the 1975 Green March / berm-era mobilisation and regional conscript states (3-7%).

weapons.note: Anchor 9-10: HIMARS, PULS, Javelin, loitering munitions.

armor.note: Anchor 9 minus: M1A1SA plus large M60/M48 fleet.

fortification.note: Anchor 9: 2,700 km Western Sahara berm, new layered SAMs.

isr.note: Anchor 9-10: Mohammed VI-A/B imaging satellites, MALE drones.

air.note: Anchor 9 minus: F-16 Block 52, F-16V upgrades pending.

gdpPerCapita.note: asOf 2025. GDP 296,682,560,556 2011 int$ (World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD rebased x 0.8005) / population 38,430,770 = 7,720 2011 int$. Range +/-10%.

gdp.note: asOf 2025. World Bank NY.GDP.MKTP.PP.KD (constant 2021 int$) 370,621,562,219 x 0.8005 (US GDP deflator 2011/2021) = 296,682,560,556 2011 int$. Range +/-10% for PPP benchmark uncertainty and the relative-price drift the rebase ignores.

milSpendShare.note: SIPRI via World Bank: 3.54% of GDP in 2025, 3.81% 2022, 2.87% 2019 (low).

industrialShare.note: asOf 2025: industry incl. construction (and hydrocarbons) 25.2% of GDP (NV.IND.TOTL.ZS). Range +/-7% for oil-price swings.

foodSurplus.note: Educated guess. Exports fruit, vegetables and fish; imports cereals in drought years.

annualCohort.note: asOf 2025. Males reaching military age per year = male population 19,372,079 x share of males aged 15-19 8.594% (SP.POP.1519.MA.5Y) / 5 = 332,950. Male population from SP.POP.TOTL.MA.IN. Males only (conscript-pool convention). Range +/-10% for single-year cohort variation.

drones.note: Educated guess. Israeli-licensed drone plant (BlueBird) announced 2022.

railKm.note: asOf 2021: 2,295 route-km (World Bank IS.RRS.TOTL.KM). Includes the Al Boraq high-speed line; CIA Factbook 2,067 km (2014).

majorPorts.note: CIA Factbook 2024: 12 ports, 3 large + 1 medium = 4; key ports Agadir, Casablanca, Tanger, Tanger-Med.

merchantTonnage.note: asOf 2025: not in the list of flags over 1,000,000 GT, so under ~1.6 million DWT; mid is an educated guess.

supplyRangeKm.note: Educated guess. Berm logistics over long desert roads.

draftAnimals.note: Educated guess. Donkeys, mules, horses, camels in agriculture; not from FAO data.

nuclearWarheads.note: Morocco is not listed among the nine nuclear-armed states in the FAS Status of World Nuclear Forces 2026 table.

homeDefense.note: Rubric 1.2: Atlas mountains, fortified berm, strong population support.

notes: Peacetime snapshot (low-intensity Western Sahara conflict with the Polisario since 2020; tension with Algeria). asOf 2025 economic data, 2026 order of battle. Border ne:MAR excludes Western Sahara; World Bank population follows the national census (includes the southern provinces), area excludes it - a known mismatch. Money in 2011 int$ via derived:ppp-rebase-2011. Counts from the Royal Moroccan Army equipment list, RMAF and Navy tables. Infantry P-role splits are educated guesses (grade D). Paramilitary (50,000) excluded.
